penuche.definition: n fudge made with brown sugar and butter and milk and nuts

penuchle.definition: n a card game played with a pack of forty-eight cards (two of each suit for high cards); play resembles whist

penult.definition: n. the next to last syllable in a word
penult.translation: n. 语尾倒数第二音节, 倒数第二个

penultima.definition: n the next to last syllable in a word
penultima.translation: n. [语]尾倒数第二音节, 倒数第二个

penultimatum.translation: n. 最后通牒发出前的声明(或要求等),半最后通牒

penumatic rammer.translation: [机] 气动捣杆, 气动舂

penumbra.definition: n. a fringe region of partial shadow around an umbra
penumbra.translation:
n. 半影, 明暗交界部分, 边缘部分, 周围的气氛
[化] 半影

penumbral.definition: a. of or pertaining to the region of partial shadow around an umbra
penumbral.translation: a. 日月半影的, 界限不明的

penumbras.definition:
plural of penumbra
n. a fringe region of partial shadow around an umbra
penumbras.translation:
(penumbra 的复数) n. 半影, 明暗交界部分, 边缘部分, 周围的气氛

penurious.definition:
s not having enough money to pay for necessities
s excessively unwilling to spend
penurious.translation: a. 赤贫的, 缺乏的, 吝啬的

penuriousness.definition:
n. a state of lacking money
n. a disposition to be niggardly with money

penury.definition: n a state of extreme poverty or destitution
penury.translation:
n. 贫困, 贫穷, 拮据, 馈乏
[法] 赤贫, 缺乏

penutian.definition:

n a member of a North American Indian people speaking one of the Penutian languages
penutian.translation:
<美>n.佩纽蒂语群(美国西部的北美印第安语群)
a. 佩纽蒂语群的
